arabic text: Naam jab binte ali ka sare bazaar aya
english translation text: When the name of Ali's daughter was called throughout the marketplace...

arabic text: hogayi shaam me haye shaam parde daaron\nko\nAaj ghar yaad asiri mein kain baar aya
english translation text: Alas, the darkness of Shaam fell\nupon the women of modesty; in\ncaptivity, she remembered her home many times.

arabic text: haye rahwaar ki gardan pe sar hai ghazi ka\nAaj kis haal me zainab ka wafadar aya
english translation text: Ghazi's head was upon the neck of a horse;\nin what condition did Zainab's faithful protector return today?

arabic text: hai darbaar me fiza se kahaan zainab ne\nSar pe chadar nahi mere bhaya mukhtar aya
english translation text: In the court, Zainab said to Fizza:\nI have no veil upon my head, yet my chosen brother has come.

arabic text: roze mehshar yeh farishton se kahegi zainab\nKholdo khuld ke darwaze aZadar aya
english translation text: On the Day of Judgement, Zainab will say to the angels:\nopen the gates of Paradise—the mourner has arrived.
